Block1 rises and then drops through ring1, centered 0.30 m below its initial center. Block1 falls another 0.25 m and touches door1, a 0.42 by 0.32 by 0.04 m, 0.45 kg hinged panel. Ball4 falls 0.30 m and drops through ring2 beneath the shelf edge. An exact rigid-contact correction requires changing a dimension.
